2529.sent:
let lookback = 1d;
let failThreshold = 30;   // FortiGate default lockout = 2 fails; 30+ from one src = automated 'forticheck' stuffing
let Failures = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where DeviceVendor has "Fortinet"
    | where Activity has_any ("login fail","ssl-login-fail","admin-login-failed") or DeviceEventClassID in ("0101039426","0100032002")
    | summarize FailCount = count(), TargetedUsers = dcount(coalesce(DestinationHostName, SourceUserName)), firstFail = min(TimeGenerated), lastFail = max(TimeGenerated) by SourceIP
    | where FailCount >= failThreshold;
let Successes = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where DeviceVendor has "Fortinet"
    | where Activity has_any ("login success","ssl-login","admin-login") or DeviceEventClassID in ("0101039424","0100032001")
    | project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, SourceIP, SuccessUser = coalesce(DestinationHostName, SourceUserName);
Failures
| join kind=inner Successes on SourceIP
| where SuccessTime between (firstFail .. lastFail + 2h)
| project SourceIP, FailCount, TargetedUsers, firstFail, lastFail, SuccessTime, SuccessUser
| order by FailCount desc

| where failures>=30 AND successes>=1

2616.def:
// GHSA-c8qj-jx8j-fg2w: DotVVM AuthorizeActionFilter does nothing. Fixed in 4.2.11, 4.3.15, 5.0.0-preview09.
DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory
| where SoftwareName has "dotvvm" or SoftwareVendor has "dotvvm"
| extend BaseVer = tostring(split(SoftwareVersion, "-")[0])
| extend PreviewNum = toint(extract(@"preview0*(\d+)", 1, tolower(SoftwareVersion)))
| where (parse_version(BaseVer) < parse_version("4.2.11"))                                              // entire <4.2.11 lineage
     or (parse_version(BaseVer) >= parse_version("4.3.0") and parse_version(BaseVer) < parse_version("4.3.15")) // 4.3.0-preview01 .. 4.3.15
     or (BaseVer == "5.0.0" and isnotnull(PreviewNum) and PreviewNum < 9)                                  // 5.0.0-preview01 .. preview09
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, OSPlatform, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion
| sort by DeviceName asc

2617.sent:

let lookback = 24h;

  | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
  | where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet" and DeviceProduct has "Fortigate"
  | where Activity has "ssl-login-fail" or DeviceEventClassID == "0101039426" or Message has "ssl-login-fail"
  | summarize Failures=count(), DistinctSrcIPs=dcount(SourceIP), TargetedUsers=make_set(DestinationHostName,50), SrcIPs=make_set(SourceIP,50), FirstFail=min(TimeGenerated), LastFail=max(TimeGenerated) by Appliance=DeviceExternalID
  | where Failures >= failThreshold and DistinctSrcIPs >= srcThreshold;
let Success = CommonSecurityLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
  | where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet" and DeviceProduct has "Fortigate"
  | where Message has "tunnel-up" or Activity has "tunnel-up" or DeviceEventClassID == "0101039947"
  | summarize SuccessCount=count(), SuccessUsers=make_set(DestinationHostName,50), SuccessSrcIPs=make_set(SourceIP,50), FirstSuccess=min(TimeGenerated) by Appliance=DeviceExternalID;
Fail
| join kind=inner Success on Appliance
| where FirstSuccess between (FirstFail .. LastFail + 1h)

id: 6f3a1c2e-9b14-4d7a-8f2b-1a7c0e5d4b21
description: Detects on-disk presence of the Jovancoding/Network-AI npm package (CVE-2026-48814, vuln <=5.7.1), whose MCP SSE server defaults to an empty authorizing secret.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r78r-rwrf-rjwp
  - https://advisories.gitlab.com/npm/network-ai/CVE-2026-46701/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1195.001
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains: '\node_modules\network-ai\'
  filter_cache:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '_cacache'
      - '\pnpm-store\'
  condition: selection and not filter_cache
level: medium
2630.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path="*\\node_modules\\network-ai\\*" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - firstTime
2630.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\node_modules\\network-ai\\/i
| NOT TargetFileName=/(_cacache|pnpm-store)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName], function=count())

2631.def:

2631.sent:

| where EventID == 4688

2631.sigma:
title: network-ai MCP SSE server launched without --stdio
id: b2d4e8f1-3a6c-4f9b-9c2e-7d1a5b8e0c34
description: Detects launch of the Network-AI MCP server in SSE (non-stdio) mode, the configuration vulnerable to the empty-default-secret auth bypass (CVE-2026-48814).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r78r-rwrf-rjwp
  - https://advisories.gitlab.com/npm/network-ai/CVE-2026-46701/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.t1133
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'network-ai'
      - 'mcp-server'
  filter_stdio:
    CommandLine|contains: '--stdio'
  condition: selection and not filter_stdio
level: medium
2631.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process="*network-ai*" Processes.process="*mcp-server*" Processes.process!="*--stdio*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - firstTime
2631.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| CommandLine=/network-ai/i
| CommandLine=/mcp-server/i
| NOT CommandLine=/--stdio/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2632.def:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "network-ai" and InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "mcp-server"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine !has "--stdio"
| where ActionType == "InboundConnectionAccepted"
| where RemoteIPType != "Loopback" and RemoteIP !in ("127.0.0.1", "::1")
| summarize Connections=count(), FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), Ports=make_set(LocalPort, 10) by DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemoteIPType, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessAccountName
| order by FirstSeen desc
2632.sent:
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where HttpMethod =~ "POST"
| where Url has "/mcp"
| where HttpStatusCode == 200
| where isempty(HttpRequestHeaderAuthorization)
| where SrcIpAddr !in ("127.0.0.1", "::1")
| project TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, HttpMethod, Url, HttpStatusCode, UserAgent=HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent
| order by TimeGenerated desc

2637.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — AutoJack: How a single page can RCE the host running your AI agent
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("malicious_web_server.py", "web_summarizer_app.py", "app.py", "bash.exe", "wsl.exe", "curl.exe", "wget.exe", "pythonw.exe") or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc "))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("malicious_web_server.py", "web_summarizer_app.py", "app.py", "bash.exe", "wsl.exe", "curl.exe", "wget.exe", "pythonw.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2637.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — AutoJack: How a single page can RCE the host running your AI agent ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("malicious_web_server.py","web_summarizer_app.py","app.py","bash.exe","wsl.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","pythonw.exe") OR Processes.process="*-enc *")
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`

| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count

id: 7f3c2a91-6b54-4d2e-9a1f-2c8d4e6f0a31
description: Node.js host process spawning an OS shell that performs environment/credential/file recon, consistent with a PraisonAI codeMode Function-constructor sandbox escape (GHSA-vmmj-pfw7-fjwp).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vmmj-pfw7-fjwp
  - https://advisories.gitlab.com/npm/praisonai/GHSA-vmmj-pfw7-fjwp/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/node'
      - '\node.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  recon:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/etc/passwd'
      - '/etc/shadow'
      - '.env'
      - 'printenv'
      - 'whoami'
      - 'child_process'
      - 'base64'
      - 'uname'
  condition: parent and child and recon
level: high
2687.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="node.exe" (Processes.process_name="cmd.exe" OR Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name="pwsh.exe" OR Processes.process_name="sh" OR Processes.process_name="bash" OR Processes.process_name="dash" OR Processes.process_name="zsh") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| search process="*/etc/passwd*" OR process="*/etc/shadow*" OR process="*.env*" OR process="*printenv*" OR process="*whoami*" OR process="*child_process*" OR process="*base64*" OR process="*cat *" OR process="*curl *" OR process="*wget *"
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2687.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\node.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE) @Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\sh.exe) @CommandLine:(*whoami* OR *.env* OR *child_process* OR *printenv* OR *base64* OR *\/etc\/passwd*)
2687.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^node(\.exe)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/(cmd\.exe|powershell\.exe|pwsh\.exe|\/sh|\/bash|\/dash|\/zsh)$/i
| regex("(/etc/passwd|/etc/shadow|\\.env|printenv|whoami|child_process|base64|uname|cat\\s)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

// Article-specific bespoke detection — Crypto Clipper uses Tor and worm-like propagation for persistence and control
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("ugate.exe", "curl.exe") or FolderPath has_any ("C:\Users\Public\Documents", "C:\Users\Public\Documents\omoho", "C:\Users\Public\Documents\"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("C:\Users\Public\Documents", "C:\Users\Public\Documents\omoho", "C:\Users\Public\Documents\") or FileName in~ ("ugate.exe", "curl.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
